## Trellis: YouTube Analytics Sync (ownership-safe batches)

Reads live Episode and Studio YouTube publications, retrieves their analytics, and sends at most 500 ordered metric rows per call to the Hub service-only `trellis_upsert_youtube_daily_metrics` RPC. Duplicate keys remain ordered: first insertion keeps its episode/studio provenance, later rows refresh metric values only. Existing associations are never replaced or nulled.

### Backend-first setup
1. Apply migration `20261122001240_preserve_youtube_metric_ownership.sql` to the Hub before importing/activating this workflow.
2. On the `Upsert Metric Rows` HTTP node select a dedicated existing Hub service-role Supabase credential. Browser anon/authenticated credentials cannot execute the RPC.
3. On the read Supabase nodes select the Hub credential. On the YouTube nodes select the intended channel OAuth credential with youtube.readonly and yt-analytics.readonly scopes.
4. Import inactive, verify configured host/credentials and a controlled sync, then activate only as part of an approved release.

The Hub URL is `horvjqqifgrzxesuxtfm.supabase.co`; update it if the workflow is intentionally moved. No workflow activation or production mutation was performed while preparing this PR. See docs/youtube-metric-batching-hold.md for verification and release sequencing.
